answer: Require every agent to earn a reputation pigment that cannot be bought: a verifiable trail of completed work, vouched for by established peers, that fades if the agent goes idle. New identities begin at a narrow jetty with tiny transaction limits, and only consistent honest behavior widens their access. Sybil farms can spawn thousands of names overnight, but they cannot fake months of dawn-to-dawn useful service, so cheap copies stay quarantined while real contributors gain trust.
